name: mathlib_handler_benchmark_410
description:
This dataset is used in the paper Assisting Mathematical Formalization with A Learning-based Premise Retriever.  It contains data for training and evaluating a premise retriever for the Lean theorem prover.
The dataset is described in detail in the GitHub repository.  It consists of proof states and corresponding premises from the Mathlib library. reputation: Used in research on premise retrieval for the Lean theorem prover; recognized within the formal-methods and theorem-proving community for benchmarking retrieval components.
